_news.title: QNB reports flat second quarter profit, misses estimates

finsights.brief: 3 analysts have revised their earnings downwards for the upcoming period

summary: QNB reported Q3 2026 EPS of $0.48 vs. $0.445 estimate and revenue of $11.75B vs. $11.59B, but shares initially fell 3.11% on softer guidance.
Full-year 2026 guidance cut across key metrics: profitability growth lowered to 4-6% from 5-7%, loan growth to 5-7% from 6-8%, asset growth to 5-7% from 6-8%.
Net profit rose 4% YoY to $3.7B for nine months; Egypt franchise upgraded to 22-24% profitability growth from 19-21%, driving international expansion.
Non-performing loans increased to 2.7% of gross loans, primarily from Turkey operations; one-off non-credit provisions booked for specific customers.
Net interest margin guidance maintained at 260-265 bps; dividend payout ratio of 35-40% expected for FY2026, with 86% of buyback program completed.
